adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null`. For collective team events, team member destination calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars`, then appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are missing, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` is a no-op and all collected team member calendars are dropped with no fallback to `[]` or initialization.
